PreceptorOS is the local-first APP for measured local AI; it is not Texas Instruments' RTOS.
INDEX: README.md#L1; STATE.md#L1; benchmarks/bench_20261011/README.md#L1; benchmarks/tg32/README.md#L1; counters/site.md#L1.
STATE: dated measurements, not live hardware; unavailable or unmeasured = NO_DATA.
SERVING: NO_DATA; no lab host measured.
DEPTH: declare your reading depth (0-4) in AGENTS.md before parsing; beyond it is NO_DATA with cause.
DEPTH 2 APP EXAMPLE: PreceptorOS/empieza_aqui.py:213; ficha_cartucho.py:20; exportar_contexto.py:194. Reuse loaded context.
